page.overview:
What is 'Adnun?

The Assamite Vizier known as 'Adnun met his future progeny, an astrologer in his early twenties, after he was impressed by his temerity. He took the youngster under his wing to prevent him from ending badly, but in time he would eventually pass to Abdalkutba the quest for Golconda itself – although his childe has spent more of his time chasing Golconda lore than actually absorbing it.
